selection_rule: Primary33 status DONE and two-sided permutation P<0.05; strict threshold; no extra rho or sensitivity filter
selection_timing: User-directed exploratory prioritization after reviewing primary results, not a predeclared confirmatory threshold
interpretation: Nominal-P exploratory candidates; not FDR-significant, functional validation or final targets
multiplicity: Preserve original652-test BH q exactly; do not recalculate q on the selected subset
scope: COAD primary associations only; retain all974 catalog rows and all missing states; other candidates remain eligible for evidence review
